The original flat P2P recommendation export (8 rows, the same shape as `backend/tests/fixtures/p2p_recommendations.json`), used to test import, inference and the missing-attribute report.

## Settings that matter
Flat rows with L0–L3 process names, pain point, intervention, evidence, confidence, metrics, benefits, feasibility, controls and oversight.

## Read by
